research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: Li7La3Zr2O12 (LLZO) cubic — REDUCED 24-atom fixture
purpose: Battery MVP known-good control (PRD §Scope) — must recover literature high-conductivity behavior of cubic LLZO. Used to drive the L1/L1.5/ionic pipeline through a stoichiometrically correct seed; full 192-atom cell loaded by adapters in materials-extras.
notes: REDUCED FIXTURE — preserves stoichiometry (Li7La3Zr2O12, one formula unit, 24 atoms) and conventional cubic a = 12.971 Å but does NOT use relaxed Wyckoff positions. Real Ia-3d (#230) crystallography with 192-atom conventional cell is recovered downstream when spglib/pymatgen are available. Not for production DFT; for fixture wiring only.
